# Devinno.UI {{VERSION}}

> SkiaSharp-based .NET 9 UI library for industrial HMI touch panels and general apps. It draws directly with SkiaSharp; a screen = XML markup (.dvml) + CSS-like inline `style` + C# view-model (VM) binding.

The documents below sit in the same folder as this file (the package's `docs/`, or `.devinno/Devinno.UI/` in your project after a build). Assume anything not listed in them does not exist.

## Always read (in this order)

1. [llm-rules.md](llm-rules.md): authoring rules. The shape of a screen, principles, choosing the built-in widget for the job, layout differences from CSS, symptom → cause → fix, code-side MUST/NEVER rules (handles, dialogs), which redraw call to make, how to verify (build, PNG, driving the app without a window), what is not supported.
2. [dvml-language.md](dvml-language.md): the markup language. Getting started, markup basics, common attributes, value rules, binding, value widgets, click/hold/disabled, `onbeforecommit`, `HandlerError`, naming, glossary.

## Choose a host

To show screens, an app also references one host adapter package; each has its own `llms.txt`.

- **Devinno.UI.OpenTK** (`ViewWindow`): the app in its own window. For kiosk panels (`fullscreen: true`), boards without desktop OpenGL 3.3 such as Raspberry Pi (`gles: true`), and scaling a fixed design size to the window (`fit: true`).
- **Devinno.UI.WinForms** (`ViewControl`): the app inside a WinForms form, Windows only. The app must target `net9.0-windows10.0.19041.0` or later.

## C# API

Devinno.UI.xml (`lib/net9.0/` in the package; the same folder as this file in `.devinno/Devinno.UI/`): C# API reference (XML doc comments, the same text IntelliSense shows). Detailed usage of DvApp, DvPage, DvBar, DvDialog, DvSurface, DvRenderer, DvTheme, AlarmLog, TrendBuffer, DvStrings, ComponentRegistry, DvWidget (custom widgets drawn in C#), FrameSource and VideoPlayer (frames and video files for `DvVideo`) and others. The namespace of each type (the `using` lines): [llm-rules.md#namespaces](llm-rules.md#namespaces).
